scope: Resend sender-domain DNS repair for the owner-only closed beta

namecheapActions.initialProblem: Resend dashboard showed DKIM verified but Enable Sending failed because send.contact MX/TXT records were not verified.

mailSettingsChange.reason: Namecheap hides MX rows from Host Records while Email Forwarding is selected. Custom MX was required to add the Resend return-path MX record.
mailSettingsChange.supportMailPreservation: The pre-existing Namecheap forwarding MX set for archestimator.com was recreated explicitly before adding the Resend subdomain MX.

authoritativeDnsProof.command: dig @dns1.registrar-servers.com +short MX archestimator.com && dig @dns1.registrar-servers.com +short MX send.contact.archestimator.com && dig @dns1.registrar-servers.com +short TXT send.contact.archestimator.com

recursiveDnsObservation.command: dig +short MX send.contact.archestimator.com && dig +short MX archestimator.com
recursiveDnsObservation.interpretation: Recursive DNS still had stale cached answers. Namecheap authoritative DNS already had all required rows.

sendProbeAfterDnsRepair.command: vercel env run -e production --scope VERCEL_SCOPE_PLACEHOLDER -- node <sanitized Resend send probe>
sendProbeAfterDnsRepair.error: The contact.archestimator.com domain is not verified. Please, add and verify your domain on https://resend.com/domains

remainingBeforeEnablingEmailDelivery: Wait for Resend verification to move from Pending to Verified.
Rerun the production-env Resend send probe and capture a success response.
Configure and prove the Resend webhook URL /api/webhooks/resend with RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET before relying on delivery/open/bounce state.
Only then set ARCHESTIMATOR_EMAIL_DELIVERY_ENABLED=true in Vercel for visible app email workflows.
